mentions.name: Calculator app for LisaGUI
mentions.description: A calculator app for LisaGUI that recreates the original Lisa calculator, using high precision fixed point arithmetic for calculations. It offers the same functionality as the original with three different modes and a toggle-able paper tape display.
mentions.source_excerpt: The Calculator app for LisaGUI. I'm using high precision fixed point arithmetic to do the calculations. It's gonna have the same functionality as the original, with three different modes and a toggle-able paper tape.
